newsitem.title: MEXICO: Top Mexican businessman Eugenio Garza hospitalized.
newsitem.headline: Top Mexican businessman Eugenio Garza hospitalized.

text.p: Eugenio Garza Laguera, a top Mexican businessman who is chairman of the board of two major companies, was hospitalized over the weekend in the northern city of Monterrey with a heart ailment, his secretary said on Monday.
Garza, 73, is chairman of the boards of Grupo Financiero Bancomer SA de CV, Mexico's second-largest bank, and Fomento Economico Mexicano SA de CV (FEMSA), a leading brewer and bottler.
"Mr. Garza Laguera is fine, but nonetheless will be taken to Houston for a more complete check-up," Lorena Coindreau, his personal secretary at FEMSA, told Reuters.
Garza also is president of the influential Monterrey Technical Institute business school and a member of the Mexican Council of Businessmen.
